none: PAS NLM-A53114: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), possibly Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful head helmeted right. Obverse inscription: [---]NTIV[--]. Reverse description: possibly two Victories facing each other. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.9mm, Weight: 1.26gms, die axis: probably 6
